title: 2357. Make Array Zero by Subtracting Equal Amounts

examples.explanation: In the first operation, choose x = 1. Now, nums = [0,4,0,2,4]. In the second operation, choose x = 2. Now, nums = [0,2,0,0,2]. In the third operation, choose x = 2. Now, nums = [0,0,0,0,0].
Each element in nums is already 0 so no operations are needed.
